title: OpenHarness: Lightweight Multi-Agent Infrastructure for LLMs
summary: An open-source Python framework that provides LLMs with tools, memory, and governance for autonomous agent workflows. It features a modular skill system and supports multi-agent orchestration across various model providers.
research_notes: Developed by HKU Data Science Lab; includes 'ohmo' personal agent for automated repository management and coding tasks.

evolution.summary: Rapidly iterated from initial release to v0.1.9 with features like Auto-Compaction and Skill Workflows. Future roadmap focuses on ClawTeam integration and enhanced multi-agent communication protocols.
